test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech. Ravi said,

"I will be joining the new office soon."

options.text: Ravi said that he joins the new office soon.
Ravi said that he would join the new office soon.
Ravi said that he will be joining the new office soon.
Ravi said that he would be joining the new office soon.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Ravi said that he would be joining the new office soon.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"will be joining" becomes "would be joining":**
 
 
• The modal verb "will" in direct speech changes to "would" in indirect speech to reflect the backshift in tense.
 
 
 
• **The subject "I" becomes "he":**
 
 
• The first-person pronoun "I" is replaced with "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb (Ravi).
 
 
 
• **The rest of the sentence remains unchanged:**
 
 
• The phrase "the new office soon" remains the same in both direct and indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is retained as it is appropriate for both direct and indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is written in reported speech format without changing the original meaning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Ravi said that he would be joining the new office soon.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Ravi said that he joins the new office soon."

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "joins" is in the present tense, which does not match the past reporting verb "said."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Ravi said that he would join the new office soon."
 
 
• Partially correct, but it does not retain the progressive aspect of "will be joining."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Ravi said that he will be joining the new office soon."
 
 
• Incorrect modal: "will" should be changed to "would" to match the rules of tense backshifting in indirect speech.
